The Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division (NSWCCD) intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price contract to only one source under the authority of FAR 13.106-1(b)(1)(i). The Contracting Officer has determined that the circumstances of this contract action deem only one source reasonably available due to proprietary data restrictions, software copyrights, and specialized Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) calibration req uirements. We work in partnership with all agencies/bodies under the aegis of the Department – a comprehensive listing including all of the Boards/Tribunals under our aegis and their functions can be found on the Department's website https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-justice-home-affairs-and-migration/ About the Managed Service Contract and the Procurement Procedure The Irish Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) verifies electronic Residence Permits (eRP) conforming to European legislation (Council Regulation 2002/1030/EC, Council Regulation 2008/380/EC, Commission Decision C (2009)3770, Commission Decision C (2011)5478). The PKI infrastructure (comprising software and High Security Module (HSM)) decrypts information on a physical card and verifies the authenticity of the card containing the encrypted information. There were approximately 340,000 eRPs processed in 2024, and approximately 320,000 in 2025. The Contracting Authority proposes to engage in a competitive process for the establishment of a contract for the provision of a Managed Service to maintain a long-standing national Public Key Infrastructure including res

ately 320,000 in 2025. Also included in this service will be expertise and per diem rates to implement new functionality in the PKI infrastructure and connected systems in the Department of Justice, Home Affairs and Migration. It is important to note that this is a critical service involving physical devices.
